svg.content: <mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"><diagram name="TX descriptor submission" id="tx-submission"><mxGraphModel grid="1" gridSize="10" page="0"><root><mxCell id="0"/><mxCell id="1" parent="0"/> <mxCell id="stop" value="<b>Disable descriptor execution</b><div><font color="#808080" style="font-size: 12px">TX_HOST_TCD_ENABLE = 0</font></div>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;verticalAlign=middle;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#000000;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=14;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="330" y="20" width="390" height="90" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="idle" value="<b>Wait until execution stops</b><div><font color="#808080" style="font-size: 12px">Poll TX_HOST_TCD_BUSY = 0</font></div><div><font color="#808080" style="font-size: 12px">Abort on timeout; initialize playback before use</font></div>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;verticalAlign=middle;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#000000;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=14;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="330" y="150" width="390" height="90" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="mode" value="<b>Select PROGRAM mode</b><div><font color="#808080" style="font-size: 12px">TX_HOST_TCD_LOOP_PROG_N = 0</font></div><div><font color="#808080" style="font-size: 12px">Timed TX parents execute once</font></div>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;verticalAlign=middle;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#000000;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=14;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="330" y="280" width="390" height="90" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="ready" value="<b>Wait for staging to be available</b><div><font color="#808080" style="font-size: 12px">Poll TX_HOST_TCD_SUBMIT_STATUS[0] = 0</font></div><div><font color="#808080" style="font-size: 12px">Require available table capacity</font></div>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;verticalAlign=middle;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#000000;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=14;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="330" y="410" width="390" height="90" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="fields" value="<b>Write parent properties</b><div><font color="#808080" style="font-size: 12px">TX_HOST_TCD_CHANNEL_COUNT = 1..4</font></div><div><font color="#808080" style="font-size: 12px">TX_HOST_TCD_BYTES_PER_CHANNEL = N * (IQ12 ? 3 : 4)</font></div><div><font color="#808080" style="font-size: 12px">TX_HOST_TCD_SAMPLES_PER_CHANNEL = N</font></div><div><font color="#808080" style="font-size: 12px">TX_HOST_TCD_IQ12 = 0 (IQ16) or 1 (IQ12)</font></div><div><font color="#808080" style="font-size: 12px">TX_HOST_TCD_FLAGS = 2</font></div>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;verticalAlign=middle;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#000000;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=14;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="330" y="540" width="390" height="150" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="time" value="<b>Write segment size and timestamp</b><div><font color="#808080" style="font-size: 12px">K = TX_HOST_TCD_BUFFER_SAMPLES (read-only)</font></div><div><font color="#808080" style="font-size: 12px">TX_HOST_TCD_SPLIT_SIZE = K * (IQ12 ? 3 : 4)</font></div><div><font color="#808080" style="font-size: 12px">TX_HOST_TCD_TIMESTAMP_HIGH = upper 32 bits</font></div><div><font color="#808080" style="font-size: 12px">TX_HOST_TCD_TIMESTAMP_LOW = lower 32 bits</font></div><div><font color="#808080" style="font-size: 12px">N is a positive multiple of K; timestamp needs lead time</font></div>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;verticalAlign=middle;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#000000;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=14;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="330" y="730" width="390" height="150" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="addr" value="<b>Write channel source DMA address</b><div><font color="#808080" style="font-size: 12px">TX_HOST_TCD_ADDRESS_INDEX = channel index (0..C-1)</font></div><div><font color="#808080" style="font-size: 12px">TX_HOST_TCD_ADDRESS_HIGH = upper 32 bits</font></div><div><font color="#808080" style="font-size: 12px">TX_HOST_TCD_ADDRESS_LOW = lower 32 bits</font></div><div><font color="#808080" style="font-size: 12px">TX_HOST_TCD_ADDRESS_WRITE = 1</font></div>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;verticalAlign=middle;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#000000;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=14;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="330" y="920" width="390" height="120" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="channels" value="<b>More channels?</b>" style="rhombus;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;verticalAlign=middle;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#000000;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=14;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="450" y="1090" width="150" height="80" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="submit" value="<b>Submit the complete parent</b><div><font color="#808080" style="font-size: 12px">TX_HOST_TCD_SUBMIT = 1</font></div><div><font color="#808080" style="font-size: 12px">Poll TX_HOST_TCD_SUBMIT_STATUS[0] = 0</font></div><div><font color="#808080" style="font-size: 12px">Keep staging unchanged while busy; abort on timeout</font></div>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;verticalAlign=middle;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#000000;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=14;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="330" y="1220" width="390" height="110" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="accepted" value="<b>Accepted?</b><div><font color="#808080" style="font-size: 12px">STATUS bit 1 = 1</font></div><div><font color="#808080" style="font-size: 12px">STATUS bit 2 = 0</font></div>" style="rhombus;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;verticalAlign=middle;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#000000;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=14;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="430" y="1380" width="190" height="110" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="error" value="<b>Inspect rejection</b><div><font color="#808080" style="font-size: 12px">Read TX_HOST_TCD_ERRORS</font></div><div><font color="#808080" style="font-size: 12px">Correct fields or wait for capacity</font></div><div><font color="#808080" style="font-size: 12px">Retry full staging sequence</font></div>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;verticalAlign=middle;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#000000;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=14;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="15" y="1370" width="285" height="120" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="more" value="<b>More parents?</b>" style="rhombus;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;verticalAlign=middle;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#000000;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=14;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="450" y="1540" width="150" height="80" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="enable" value="<b>Enable HostTCD execution</b><div><font color="#808080" style="font-size: 12px">TX_HOST_TCD_ENABLE = 1</font></div><div><font color="#808080" style="font-size: 12px">Acceptance does not release source DMA buffers</font></div>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;verticalAlign=middle;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#000000;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=14;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="330" y="1690" width="390" height="90" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="edge1" value="" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=classic;" edge="1" parent="1" source="stop" target="idle"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"></mxGeometry></mxCell> <mxCell id="edge2" value="" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=classic;" edge="1" parent="1" source="idle" target="mode"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"></mxGeometry></mxCell> <mxCell id="edge3" value="" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=classic;" edge="1" parent="1" source="mode" target="ready"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"></mxGeometry></mxCell> <mxCell id="edge4" value="" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=classic;" edge="1" parent="1" source="ready" target="fields"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"></mxGeometry></mxCell> <mxCell id="edge5" value="" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=classic;" edge="1" parent="1" source="fields" target="time"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"></mxGeometry></mxCell> <mxCell id="edge6" value="" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=classic;" edge="1" parent="1" source="time" target="addr"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"></mxGeometry></mxCell> <mxCell id="edge7" value="" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=classic;" edge="1" parent="1" source="addr" target="channels"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"></mxGeometry></mxCell> <mxCell id="edge8" value="Yes: next channel" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=classic;" edge="1" parent="1" source="channels" target="addr"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"><Array as="points"><mxPoint x="765" y="1130"/><mxPoint x="765" y="980"/></Array></mxGeometry></mxCell> <mxCell id="edge9" value="No" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=classic;" edge="1" parent="1" source="channels" target="submit"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"></mxGeometry></mxCell> <mxCell id="edge10" value="" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=classic;" edge="1" parent="1" source="submit" target="accepted"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"></mxGeometry></mxCell> <mxCell id="edge11" value="No" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=classic;" edge="1" parent="1" source="accepted" target="error"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"><Array as="points"></Array></mxGeometry></mxCell> <mxCell id="edge12" value="Retry" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;endArrow=classic;" edge="1" parent="1" source="error" target="ready"><mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"><Array as="points"><mxPoint x="157" svg.title: HostTCD TX descriptor submission
svg.desc: Stage TX source addresses, sample format, sample counts and timestamp, submit and check acceptance, then enable program-mode execution.

g.text: Abort on timeout; initialize playback before use
Wait for staging to be available
N is a positive multiple of K; timestamp needs lead time
Keep staging unchanged while busy; abort on timeout
Correct fields or wait for capacity
Acceptance does not release source DMA buffers
